text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back from our outing, Narita Brian and I decided to eat dinner together, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Any fast food will do.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't take much time, and we can take it to go.
Not a bad option, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, if it isn't Brian!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: What're you doing in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm just heading out to get some fast food.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Fast food? Don't tell me that's your dinner!
Sheesh, what am I going to do with you...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And you're not off the hook either, Trainer!
Managing her diet is your job, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, hey. I just thought of something good.
Come with me for a sec!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: H-Hey...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Alright, tell me what you want to eat tonight!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What in the world...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Brian. You really ought
to eat better food, you know.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Even at the academy, you just grab a stuffed bread for lunch and rarely use the cafeteria, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"The cafe's crowded and annoying.
I just want to eat in peace by myself."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That might be true, but living off stuffed bread
is gonna mess up your nutrition, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "If you go to a cafe, they'll serve you a well-balanced meal without you having to think about it, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Anything is fine as long as it fills the stomach.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Of course it's not fine!
Don't you have any favorite foods or anything?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...So noisy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "Why do you care so much about what I eat, Ama-san? It has nothing to do with you."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Doesn't matter...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Argh, logic doesn't matter right now!
I'm saying this because I'm worried about you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You wouldn't want your rival
falling sick over something totally unrelated to racing, would you?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's why...! If you're not in top shape,
I'm the one who's gonna suffer here!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Anyway.
...I understand what you're trying to say, Ama-san."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll cut out fast food.
Will that satisfy you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If you've understood...
then that's all that matters. Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, in that case, I'll make dinner for us!
Anything in particular you feel like eating?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Whatever.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "Saying 'anything' is the most troublesome... Just give me something, anything!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Then you decide.
You are my Trainer, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I'll leave it to you, please.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
A well-balanced meal, huh! Leave it to me!
Big Sis Hishi Ama will whip up something amazing!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Be sure to look forward to it~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I'll keep my expectations moderate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I heard later on that the meal Hishi Amazon
made for them was delicious.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Since we have the chance,
something like that sounds fine too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Stamina, huh... All right, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'll whip up a hearty dish
that'll pack a ton of stamina into ya!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Extra meat, please.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, I knew you'd say that!
Yeah, yeah, just leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing about it later, it wasn't as greasy as I'd imagined,
and was actually very delicious.
